population: All 32 capability-qualified matched-v2 is/was A1/A2 rows, with the frozen exact MLP4 left_change+right_change writer installed only at moment+determiner.

predictions.pred_d_interaction_is_secondary: Routing plus local value without interaction retains >=0.80 of full recovery with direction >=0.75 in A1 and A2.
